philosophy.heading: BEYOND THE PLATE
philosophy.subheading: A Culinary Journey of Passion, Leadership, and Global Excellence
philosophy.body: Every chef has a story, but some journeys are defined not only by the dishes they create but by the lives they inspire, the teams they build, and the cultures they embrace. My journey in the culinary world is one such story — a journey that began with a dream and evolved into a lifelong pursuit of excellence.
philosophy.quote: Food is more than nourishment. It is culture, emotion, memory, and connection.

career.heading: A JOURNEY ACROSS CONTINENTS
career.subheading: From foundational mastery in Kolkata and Mumbai to executive leadership across the Maldives, Zanzibar, Dubai, Tanzania, and Lagos.

expertise.heading: EXPERTISE THAT GOES BEYOND THE KITCHEN
expertise.subheading: Comprehensive restaurant consultancy, menu engineering, team mastery, and kitchen architecture.
